accepted_slices.title: Native Rust client and CLI with unchanged upstream C++ source interfaces and acceptance tests
Reviewed security fixes, enforced CI, dependency audits and clean package/install validation
Owner-specific public progress reporting guidance merged after required CI passed
Foundation copyright notices and required attribution in Rust packages and native installs

quality.note: Verified Linux scope: 55 Rust unit tests, 2 CLI tests, 8 Python validation tests and 21 C++ suites. The 128 upstream C++ cases run unchanged in 19 suites; two supplementary suites add 11 cases. Rust-port and partial counts are not asserted. C++ line coverage is 1319/1359; region coverage is unmeasured. All 17 retained public headers match upstream. The 27-file Rust crate includes NOTICE; native install and relocation checks verify LICENSE/NOTICE. CI and metrics refer to PR #9's tested head; the accepted main commit is listed separately. Downstream C++ rebuilds are required; Windows/macOS and release publication are not claimed. FUEL-01 acceptance belongs to gz-sim.
